servinfo.title: Timing Chain Cover Removal and Installation

s1.ptxt: Remove engine assembly from vehicle.
Remove water pump / generator drive belt.
Remove crankshaft pulley bolt (1).
To lock crankshaft pulley (2), use special tool as shown in figure.
Remove crankshaft pulley (1).
If it is hard to remove, use special tools.
Remove cylinder head cover.
Remove oil pan and oil pump strainer.
Remove water pump / generator drive belt tensioner pulley (1).
Remove water pump pulley.
Remove timing chain cover.
Remove crankshaft oil seal from timing chain cover using a flat-bladed screwdriver or the like, if necessary.
Remove timing chain cover O-ring (1), oil pump O-ring (2) and gasket (3).
Remove filter (4) from timing chain cover, if necessary.
Remove OCV from timing chain cover, if necessary.
Remove oil pressure switch from timing chain cover, if necessary.
Remove oil pump from timing chain cover.
Clean mating surfaces of timing chain cover, cylinder block and cylinder head removing oil, old sealant and dust.
Install oil pump to timing chain cover, if removed.
Press-fit new oil seal (1) into timing chain cover (2) using special tool (A) as shown in figure.
Check cleanliness of filter (1) and install it to timing chain cover (2), if removed.
Apply engine oil to new gasket (3) and install it to timing chain cover.
Apply engine oil to new timing chain cover O-ring (4), new oil pump O-ring (5) and install each one to oil pump (6) and timing chain cover.
Check that dowel pins are installed to cylinder block.
Clean mating surface of timing chain cover, cylinder block and cylinder head.
Clean mating portions (1) of cylinder block and cylinder head with cleaning solvent particularly.
Apply sealant “A” to mating surface of timing chain cover as shown in figure.

spec.title: Sealant bead size for timing chain cover

s1.ptxt: Install timing chain cover noting the following points.

item.ptxt: Apply engine oil to oil seal lip.
Align straight lines (1) of oil pump inner rotor with straight lines (2) of crankshaft sprocket.
Install timing chain cover within 2 minutes after applying sealant.
Check O-rings and gasket for proper fit.
Use care so that oil seal lip is not damaged and oil seal spring is not coming off.

s1.ptxt: Tighten timing chain cover bolts No.1 and No.2 in numerical order (“1” – “15”) evenly and gradually to specified torque.
Wipe off excessive sealant squeezed out from timing chain cover at the lower end.
Install oil pressure switch to timing chain cover, if removed.
Install OCV, if removed.
Install water pump pulley.
Install water pump / generator drive belt tensioner pulley (1) and tighten water pump / generator drive belt tensioner pulley bolt (2) to specified torque.

torqueitem.t-part: Water pump / generator drive belt tensioner pulley bolt

s1.ptxt: Install cylinder head cover.
Install oil pump strainer and oil pan.
Clean crankshaft pulley and apply engine oil to sealing surface (1).
Insert crankshaft pulley (1) aligning key groove (2) with key (3) on crankshaft.

attention4.ptxt: Turning over of oil seal lip or coming off of the inside spring will cause oil leakage.
While inserting crankshaft pulley, pay attention not to damage oil seal lip nor disengage the inside spring.

s1.ptxt: Hold crankshaft pulley (1) with special tool and tighten crankshaft pulley bolt (2) according to the following procedure.

s2.ptxt: Tighten crankshaft pulley bolt to 19 N·m (1.9 kgf-m, 14.0 lbf-ft).

s1.ptxt: Install water pump / generator drive belt.
Install engine assembly to vehicle.
